51550623.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Full-length human PRMT5/human MEP50 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: A surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay confirmed its direct binding to PRMT5 with a Kd value of 6 nM. Interestingly, despite being a close derivative of the cofactor SAM, compound 1 showed 100-fold greater selectivity against other methyltransferases and nonprmt5 targets. To provide a structural basis for its high potency and selectivity, the cocrystal structure of 1 complexed with PRMT5:MEP50 was resolved, and its location in the SAM binding pocket (Figure 2A) was validated. Moreover, the C6-NH2 and N1 atom of 7-deazapurine form hydrogen bonds with the Asp419 carboxylate and the Met420 backbone, respectively, furnishing structural insights into the high potency. More importantly, the phenyl group of 1 occupies the side chain of Phe327, a residue specific to PRMT5, thereby uncovering a structural basis for its high selectivity.
